newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open slightly firmer Friday, in line with LME copper prices, after only a small rise in LME warehouse copper stocks.
COMEX July copper was seen opening unchanged to up 0.30 cent a pound from Thursday's close at $119.25 cents.
LME warehouse stocks rose 200 tonnes to 133,225 tonnes Friday, after COMEX copper stocks rose 242 short tons Thursday to 43,173 tons.
With world refined copper stocks at less than three weeks of consumption there is little cushion against supply disruptions, analysts said.
Expectations that Chinese buying will emerge later this year may also provide support, but in the U.S. Kennecott Utah Copper's smelter was fired up Tuesday after a 42-day shutdown.
